title: Decoupling and Discrete Strichartz Estimates for Dispersive Equations on the Torus
summary: This paper proves weighted discrete Strichartz, or equivalently discrete restriction, estimates for two-dimensional exponential sums with fractional and perturbed polynomial phases. The new results cover three related classes of curves: the fractional Schrödinger-type curve $(n,n^{1+ν})$, the fully fractional curve $(n^{1+μ},n^{1+ν})$ with $0<μ<ν$, and bounded perturbations of the polynomial curve $(n,n^k)$. In each case we obtain $\ell^2$-weighted $L^p$ estimates with decoupling-type dependence on the frequency scale, including both low- and high-$p$ regimes. The proofs are based on…
